summary: NanoViricides, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 2,416,339 shares of common stock at $1.53 per share, plus pre-funded warrants for 100,000 shares and common warrants for 2,516,339 shares at a $1.75 exercise price. The offering price equaled the July 23, 2026 closing price, implying no premium. D. Boral Capital acted as placement agent on a reasonable-best-efforts basis, earning a 7% cash fee. Proceeds before expenses were approximately $3.58 million. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
